resources.string: Make another parent an admin. If this phone is lost, an admin is needed to invite phones again; without one the family has to create a new group.
Admins can invite and remove phones. This cannot be undone without pairing that phone again.

The phone stops syncing with the group. To come back, it has to be disconnected in its own settings (“Disconnect this phone and pair again”) and invited again. Until a future update of Kinsight it can still recognise your family\'s phones nearby over Bluetooth.

Everyone in the group will be told that this phone left. The group\'s data on this phone will be deleted. Data already on their phones stays until their retention ends. Coming back needs a new invitation.
You are the only admin. Make another parent an admin first, or remove the other phones.
This phone is not in a family group.
Not in the group any more
This phone was removed from the family group or has left it.
This phone is no longer an active member of a family group, so there is nothing to leave.
Leaving was refused: other phones are still in the group and this phone is their only admin. Make another parent an admin, or remove the other phones, then leave.
Could not record that this phone is leaving. Nothing was deleted; try again.
Your family was told that this phone left, but clearing this phone failed. Tap Start over to finish.
Could not make this member an admin.
On the phone you are adding, open Kinsight, choose Join with a QR code and scan this code. Keep both phones close.
Bluetooth is busy, retrying. Keep this screen open.
Other phones may not find this phone right now. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then make a new code.
The code could not be shown. If you are not sure this is the phone in front of you, decline and start a new invitation.
Add only if the phone in front of you shows the same digits.
“%1$s” is in the group. Its first data arrives within a few minutes while the phones are close.
Looking for %1$s\'s phone. Keep it close, with the invitation open.
Waiting for %1$s to confirm on their phone. Their screen shows the same code.
Waiting for %1$s to confirm on their phone. The code could not be shown; if you are not sure, cancel and start again.
You are in the family group.
Allow Nearby devices for Kinsight in the app settings, then try again.
Turn on Bluetooth and try again.
Bluetooth is not available right now. Try again.
The admin\'s phone was not found. Keep both phones close, keep the invitation open and try again.
This is not the phone that showed the invitation.
This QR code is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
This QR code is no longer valid: it expired. Ask for a new one.
The admin declined or closed the invitation.
This phone was removed from the group before. To join again, disconnect it and pair again: it joins as a new device with the same invitation.
The invitation or the answer was not valid. If either phone has an older Kinsight, update the app and try again.
This phone is already in a group. Leave it first.
This phone\'s keys are broken. Use “Disconnect this phone and pair again” in Settings.
Leaving was refused: the family\'s storage is on your Yandex Disk. Hand it to another parent in Settings first, then leave.
The storage is moving to another Disk. You can leave once every phone has switched to it. A phone that no longer syncs can be removed from the group.
Sync through Yandex Disk turns off. The data stays on the phones, and Bluetooth goes on working.
